goals: Verify that the SVD function, when given a Matrix input, returns an object of type Scalar, OrderedPair, or Matrix.
activities: Reshape the 9x9 identity matrix to a 3x3x3x3 matrix.
Create a Matrix object from the 5x5 identity matrix.
Attempt to compute SVD using the Matrix object.
If a np.linalg.LinAlgError occurs, create a Matrix object from the 3x3x3x3 matrix and compute SVD using it.
Assert that the SVD result is an instance of Scalar, OrderedPair, or Matrix.
